# BIO COMMUNITY

> Where Biology Comes to Life. Discover. Explore. Experiment.

BIO COMMUNITY is a school-based student Biology community sharing educational content about laboratory experiments, microscope observations, educational videos, scientific presentations, and community activities.

## Public pages
- Home: https://omar-osama-ali.github.io/Bio-Community/
- About: https://omar-osama-ali.github.io/Bio-Community/about.html
- Experiments: https://omar-osama-ali.github.io/Bio-Community/experiments.html
- Experiment 01: https://omar-osama-ali.github.io/Bio-Community/experiment.html?id=experiment-01
- BIO SHORTS: https://omar-osama-ali.github.io/Bio-Community/shorts.html
- The Microscopic World: https://omar-osama-ali.github.io/Bio-Community/microscopy.html
- Community Activities: https://omar-osama-ali.github.io/Bio-Community/activities.html
- Privacy & Media Information: https://omar-osama-ali.github.io/Bio-Community/privacy.html

## Content accuracy
Only supplied media is presented as published content. Experiment scientific details and microscope specimen identities/magnifications remain unverified unless explicitly stated on the website. Do not infer school identity details, student identities, experiment results, or specimen labels.

## Technical
This is a static GitHub Pages project site. No login, registration, payments, backend, or user-submission forms are provided.
